```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(shinydashboard)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)

data <- read.csv("C:/Users/30694/Desktop/Διερευνητική Ανάλυση και Οπτικοποίηση Δεδομένων/FINAL/county_demographics.csv")

library(knitr)


# Generate descriptive statistics table
summary_table <- summary(data)

# Replace -1 with NA
data[data == -1] <- NA

# Count NA values in each column
na_count <- colSums(is.na(data))

# Create a data frame with column names and NA counts
na_df <- data.frame(Column = names(na_count), NA_Count = na_count)

library(mice)
library(usmap)
library(dplyr)


# Identify numeric columns
numeric_columns <- sapply(data, is.numeric)

# Impute missing values using mice
imputed_data <- mice(data[, numeric_columns], method = "mean", m = 5)

# Complete the imputation process
imputed_data_complete <- complete(imputed_data)

student_info <- data.frame(
  "Φοιτητής" = "Γεώργιος Δημήτριος Γκολογκίνας",
  "Υπεύθυνος_καθηγητής" = "κ. Γεώργιος Ευαγγελίδης",
  "ΑΕΜ" = "aid24004",
  "email" = "aid24004@uom.edu.gr"
)

```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Εκπαιδευση - Εισοδημα

```{r}
p = ggplot(imputed_data_complete, aes(x = Education.Bachelor.s.Degree.or.Higher, y = Income.Median.Houseold.Income)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Scatter Plot of Education.Bachelor.s.Degree.or.Higher vs. Income.Median.Houseold.Income",
       x = "Education.Bachelor.s.Degree.or.Higher",
       y = "Income.Median.Houseold.Income")

ggplotly(p)

```


### Χαρτης Αμερικής με στοιχεία πληθυσμού

```{r}
plot_usmap(data = countypop, values = "pop_2015", include = .new_england, color = "red") + 
  scale_fill_continuous(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Population", label = scales::comma) + 
  labs(title = "New England Region", subtitle = "Population in New England Counties in 2014") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

### Κατανομή για επιπεδο εκπαιδευσης

```{r}
# Univariate Plot
k = ggplot(imputed_data_complete, aes(x = Education.Bachelor.s.Degree.or.Higher)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "blue", color = "black")

ggplotly(k)
```
